facts.fact: Kit 自述距那晚已四个月，他居然还在这里。
facts.anchor: It’s been four months since the night everything changed, and somehow, I’m still here.

facts.fact: Soren 低沉地哼了一声，命令 Kit 不准离开庄园。
facts.anchor: He grunts, deep and final. “Kit doesn’t leave the estate.”

facts.fact: Lorraine 对 Kit 说“对不起，亲爱的”，转身走向前门。
facts.anchor: Softly she says, “Sorry, dear,” before turning and walking away toward the front doors.

facts.fact: Soren 指出 Kit 已经和 Lorraine 在外面待过、不必黏着她。
facts.anchor: “You’ve already spent time with her outside. You don’t need to be glued to her.”

facts.fact: 门在两人身后关上，锁咔哒落上。
facts.anchor: The door clicks shut behind us, then the lock turns.

facts.fact: Soren 把 Kit 的双手拉到背后，用皮带紧紧缠住手腕。
facts.anchor: He pulls them together behind my back in one firm movement and starts wrapping the warm, stiff leather around them, tight and deliberate.

facts.fact: Soren 对 Kit 说，给他一次说不的机会。
facts.anchor: “I’ll give you one chance to say no, Kit.”

facts.fact: Soren 一巴掌打在 Kit 屁股上，质问他是不是自己允许他射的。
facts.anchor: Soren growls, before a sharp, stinging smack lands on my ass. “Did I say you could come?”
